tag: Atlantic coast · Fernandina to Jupiter, FL
headline: Gale WARNING now up for Florida's Atlantic coast
what: Yesterday's watch is now a warning: NE winds 25–35 kt, gusts to 40, seas 8–15 ft from Fernandina to Jupiter Inlet. Gale watch south to Ocean Reef from Sunday.
why: A multi-day northeaster makes every Atlantic inlet dangerous for sailboats, and the open ICW stretches will be gusty and rough.
todo: No outside passages or inlet runs. Stay inside, take short ICW hops, double your lines and add chafe gear.
source: National Weather Service Jacksonville, Melbourne & Miami

headline: Miami Marine Stadium basin closed for races
what: A Coast Guard safety zone covers all of Miami Marine Stadium Harbor for the Luminsea Miami Shootout powerboat races.
why: The Marine Stadium basin off the Rickenbacker Causeway is off-limits to boats through Sunday night unless the Coast Guard says otherwise.
todo: Anchor elsewhere until Monday. To request entry: VHF 16 or (833) 642-7271.
